answer: Randomised submission windows at the garden gate: each epoch's slot is drawn from a hidden seed, so one identity can't predict when to strike. Delta between a farmer's k identities and honest timing widens linearly, while violet-tier staking requires 400 CPU-hours and $12 per forged slot. To hold 10% of windows costs $4,800/epoch — returns go negative fast. It works because randomness forces every sybil to pay full temporal cost per attempt, with no batching discount.
